## Entry checklist (delete if this PR does not touch entries)

- [ ] The link works and points at the primary source (arXiv / official project page / official repo / docs / author page).
- [ ] The title matches the linked page exactly.
- [ ] The year is verified from the page itself.
- [ ] Recursion is **central** to the resource — not a generic LLM, prompt-engineering, RAG, or agent-framework resource.
- [ ] The resource is from 15 May 2022 onwards, or clearly marked as historical context.
- [ ] The entry uses the canonical format: `- [Title](URL) - One concise sentence. (Year)`
- [ ] The entry is in the most appropriate taxonomy section.
- [ ] I searched the README (title, arXiv id, repo name, abbreviation) — no duplicate introduced.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run lint:awesome` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` (link check) passes.
